chosen.title: a young man stretches his arms on the balcony
chosen.faces: frontal, but backlit and small in a wide shot; acceptable (faces=ok)
chosen.why: Cross-body shoulder stretch on a rooftop in natural daylight: at 3.4s the right arm locks across the chest with the left hand gripping the elbow, so 'shoulder' reads on the first frame and the hold carries the 0.7s cut. 16:9 1080p, no text/logo/watermark, muted natural palette (sky/grey terrace) that will grade down easily. Demerits: wide full-body framing keeps the subject small, and it is a shoulder stretch rather than a literal shoulder roll.

alternates.why: Medium frontal shot of a cross-body shoulder stretch in a park, golden natural light; the most legible shoulder gesture of all candidates. Held back because the sports bra band carries clearly readable 'ACTIVE ACTIVE' brand text across the frame. Side-profile version of the same stretch at 0.0-2.5s also usable.

Woman from behind at a bedroom window, hands clasped behind neck with elbows out (neck/shoulder loosening). No text, no face. Weaker read of 'shoulder' and a warm, slightly blown-out look; home rather than city setting.

notes: All four supplied queries ('shoulder stretch', 'shoulder pain', 'rolling shoulders office', 'stretching shoulders') returned 0 results because mixkit.py builds a single Mixkit /discover/<slug>/ URL and multi-word slugs 404. Worked around with single-word queries 'stretching' (20 hits), 'shoulder' (only over-the-shoulder shots, useless) and 'neck' (20 hits). Downloaded 52120, 40761, 50759, 31407 (all 1080p). 52120 (woman on city street) turned out to be a wrist stretch, forward bends and side bends; the only shoulder-ish beat is her brushing hair back at ~22s, so rejected. No candidate shows a literal shoulder ROLL; the chosen clip is a cross-body shoulder stretch, which reads 'shoulder' faster than a subtle roll would at 0.7s. An un-downloaded lead if a literal roll is required: mixkit 14643 'man with neck pain' (back view, black tank, studio) from the 'neck' sheet, and 33744 'shirtless man with neck pain' (bare back/shoulders). Second usable in-point on the chosen clip: 11.4s (mirror-side stretch).
